text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Participants at 19th congress of Arab Lawyers Union call for stabilization of Arab solidarity.
- Arab lawyers praise President Ben Ali for his role in reinforcing Arab unity.
- Tunisia elected Vice-President of the 33rd summit of the Organisation of African Unity (OAU) being held in Zimbabwe.
- Red meat production in the southern region of Kef estimated at 7,950 tonnes in 1997, from 6,800 in 1996.
- Heavy rain and hail storms hit different regions despite summer.
